title: Severe Burn
immediate_warning: Call 112 now. Do not remove clothing stuck to the burn.

immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Call 112 now. Do not remove clothing stuck to the burn.

description: A severe burn damages deep layers of skin and tissue. It is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate hospital care.

description_translations.en: A severe burn damages deep layers of skin and tissue. It is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate hospital care.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A severe burn damages deep layers of skin and tissue. It is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate hospital care.

description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A severe burn damages deep layers of skin and tissue. It is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate hospital care.

signs: Severe pain or no pain (nerve damage)

2.en: Severe pain or no pain (nerve damage)
2.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe pain or no pain (nerve damage)
2.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe pain or no pain (nerve damage)

2.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Severe pain or no pain (nerve damage)

steps.instruction: Remove the person from the source of heat. Stop any flames by rolling them on the ground.

instruction_translations.en: Remove the person from the source of heat. Stop any flames by rolling them on the ground.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove the person from the source of heat. Stop any flames by rolling them on the ground.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove the person from the source of heat. Stop any flames by rolling them on the ground.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove the person from the source of heat. Stop any flames by rolling them on the ground.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Remove the person from the source of heat. Stop any flames by rolling them on the ground.

steps.instruction: Cool the burn with cool running water for at least 20 minutes.

instruction_translations.en: Cool the burn with cool running water for at least 20 minutes.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cool the burn with cool running water for at least 20 minutes.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cool the burn with cool running water for at least 20 minutes.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cool the burn with cool running water for at least 20 minutes.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cool the burn with cool running water for at least 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Do NOT remove clothing stuck to the burn — cut around it carefully.

instruction_translations.en: Do NOT remove clothing stuck to the burn — cut around it carefully.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do NOT remove clothing stuck to the burn — cut around it carefully.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do NOT remove clothing stuck to the burn — cut around it carefully.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do NOT remove clothing stuck to the burn — cut around it carefully.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do NOT remove clothing stuck to the burn — cut around it carefully.

steps.instruction: Cover loosely with a clean sheet, cling wrap, or a sterile dressing.

instruction_translations.en: Cover loosely with a clean sheet, cling wrap, or a sterile dressing.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cover loosely with a clean sheet, cling wrap, or a sterile dressing.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cover loosely with a clean sheet, cling wrap, or a sterile dressing.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cover loosely with a clean sheet, cling wrap, or a sterile dressing.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cover loosely with a clean sheet, cling wrap, or a sterile dressing.

steps.instruction: Keep the person warm to prevent shock. Elevate burned limbs if possible.

instruction_translations.en: Keep the person warm to prevent shock. Elevate burned limbs if possible.

instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person warm to prevent shock. Elevate burned limbs if possible.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person warm to prevent shock. Elevate burned limbs if possible.

steps.instruction: Monitor breathing and consciousness until help arrives.
